Subject: Intro + initial discovery call / demo: Redwood & Pegasus Manufacturing

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Great to meet you both virtually — thanks for taking the time to explore Redwood. I'm Marissa (AE) and I'll run the kickoff and coordinate. I'd like to get a 45-minute discovery + demo on the calendar to cover:
- High-level goals & success metrics
- Architecture & data flows
- Priorities: latency / cost / security
- Live walkthrough of relevant features

Can you confirm which of these windows work on your side (PT):
- Tue Jul 6: 09:00 - 09:45
- Tue Jul 6: 11:00 - 11:45
- Wed Jul 7: 14:00 - 14:45

I'll include Dev (Solutions Engineer) on the call so we can get into technical details. I've attached our short deck as background. If there's anyone else you'd like on the call (procurement/security/infra), please add them and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marissa

Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
